paragraphs: Mentioned in [Yevamot 8a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.8a.19): Rav Acha bar Bibi Mar said to Ravina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Yevamot has Rav Acha bar Bibi Mar address Ravina. The continuation has him cite Rava. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=312&lang=en) records that transmission.
Hyman’s notice excerpts the address alone and preserves the form Bibi Mar.
